question: In which of the following countries is the ancient Hindu shrine called Shawala Teja Singh Temple located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **Pakistan's Punjab province**, the **city of Sialkot** is home to the **revered Shivala Teja Singh Temple.**
 
• **Teja Singh** constructed the temple.
 
• It is **dedicated to Shiva.**
 
• During the **Partition in 1947,** the temple was **sealed.**
 
• The temple was** partially destroyed** by **criminals in 1992.**
 
• **Local Hindu leaders** encouraged the **Pakistani government** to ensure the **repairs were done** as soon as possible in** 2015.**
 
• **Imran Khan, the prime minister**, reopened the **Hindu temple after 72 years.**
 
• In order to facilitate p**ilgrim visits and other ceremonies**, the Pakistani government **restored and officially** turned over the centuries-old Shawala Teja Singh Temple to the** Pakistan Hindu Council in 2019. **
